items.label: 5-PIECE PATIO FURNITURE SET COVER
items.value: This Loriano outdoor furniture cover includes 2 chair covers, 1 loveseat cover, 1 sofa cover and 1 coffee table cover.

items.label: DEMENSIONS
items.value: This cover is not made for oversized patio set. Armchair cover fits up to 31"W x 30"D x 30"H(Actual Cover Size: 33"W x 32"D x 31"H). Loveseat cover fits up to 56"W x 30.5"D x 30"H(Actual Cover Size: 58"W x 32"D x 31"H). Sofa Cover fits up to 77"W x 34"Dx 32"H(Actual Cover Size: 79"W x 35"Dx 33"H).Coffee table cover fits up to 47"W x 24.5"Dx 13"H(Actual Cover Size: 46"W x 26"D x 13"H).

items.label: WATERPROOF
items.value: Heavy duty 100% 600D Oxford water-resistant top fabric with added UV-stabilized coating and waterproof undercoating is made to protect your patio furniture cover from natural damage and outdoor elements like sun, dirt, rain, snow.

items.label: WINDPROOF
items.value: The elastic hem cord with adjustable toggle allows you to make a tight custom fit on the bottom of the furniture covers. Buckled straps over legs provide extraordinary security on the windiest days.

items.label: EASY TO USE
items.value: Large padded handles make easy to lift and remove the outdoor patio furniture covers, and air vents reduce inside condensation and wind.
